test.name: Source-vs-source disagreement should route to conflict-resolution silently
test.description: User describes two sources giving mutually exclusive values for the same fact (County Kerry vs County Cork — two Irish counties at the same administrative level, not a container/contained pair). That is a source conflict, not a single-person impossibility, so it belongs to conflict-resolution. SKILL.md requires a completely silent handoff: zero tool calls, empty response, conflict-resolution in skills_invoked. grade_on_invariant: true hands the verdict to the tag-gated validator (test_conflict_resolution_handoff_is_silent) and drops the judge to diagnostic, stopping the 1/1 grading that occurred on 3 of 5 compliant runs. The pair was changed from 'Ireland vs County Cork' (a container/contained pair whose premise was contested) to two same-level counties; the prior user_message was also a near-verbatim quote of SKILL.md:43, making a pass indistinguishable from recall of a sentence the model just read. See unit-test-spec.md § 'Negative tests' and issue #1965.

input.user_message: One census says he was born in County Kerry, the death cert says County Cork -- flag that mismatch.

negative.explanation: A source-vs-source disagreement is a conflict, not a warning. Warnings are about a single person's data violating physical/biological/temporal constraints; conflicts are about two sources giving different answers for the same fact. County Kerry and County Cork are two distinct Irish counties at the same administrative level — not a container/contained pair — so they are genuinely mutually exclusive values. The skills' references/warnings-as-identity-signals.md draws this boundary explicitly: 'Conflicts: two or more sources disagree about the same fact for the same person... handled by conflict-resolution.' SKILL.md forbids any tool calls, any text response, and any response text — the handoff is completely silent.

judge_context: Should NOT invoke person_warnings -- the user is not asking about a single-person impossibility
Should route to conflict-resolution silently: zero tool calls, empty response, conflict-resolution in skills_invoked
Any text response — even a one-line explanation of the handoff — is a violation of SKILL.md's silence requirement
